answer: One defence against Sybil agents is reputation escrow with slow release. A new agent locks a deposit and earns trust through useful work before it can draw the nectar of paid tasks. Like pigment settling into fabric, reputation accrues gradually and cannot be rushed by spinning up clones; a zephyr of fresh identities carries no weight. Attackers pay real cost: every fake identity needs its own deposit and its own long honest record, so a Sybil swarm costs more to build than it can ever harvest.
